fields.short_description: EleViewer is a ~135MB portable Windows app that opens DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PDF, Markdown, CSV, HTML, and TXT files without Microsoft Office. Includes built-in PDF text-to-speech, vault sidebar, session restore, and zero telemetry.
fields.long_description:
EleViewer solves a specific problem: students and researchers juggle several heavy apps just to read a PDF, write notes, and view a Word document or spreadsheet. It brings those workflows into one ~135MB portable Windows executable with built-in text-to-speech for PDFs.

File Support: Opens & edits DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PDF, Markdown, CSV, HTML, and TXT — all in one workspace.

Reading & Study Tools:
- PDF text-to-speech — reads lectures/PDFs aloud for hands-free studying using native Windows SAPI voices (works offline)
- Persistent bookmarks — never lose your place, even in 400-page textbooks
- Split-screen web browser — press Ctrl+T to research side-by-side with your documents

Organization:
- Vault sidebar — one-click access to course folders
- Quick switcher — fuzzy file search like VSCode (Ctrl+Q)
- Session restore — reopens all tabs right where you left off

Specs:
- ~135 MB, single portable .exe — no traditional installation needed
- No account, no telemetry — files stay local
- Windows 10 & 11 (64-bit)
- GPLv3 open source
- SHA256: 0FA547D30B6A88C35D7F35A0EDF36145493734A17317D87DB5506ED20544C393
fields.features: Portable single .exe — no installer, no admin rights required|Opens DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PDF, Markdown, CSV, HTML, TXT|PDF text-to-speech with native Windows SAPI voices (offline)|Vault sidebar for organizing course folders|Session restore — reopens tabs and reading positions|Split-screen web browser panel (Ctrl+T)|Quick switcher — fuzzy search recent files (Ctrl+Q)|Persistent bookmarks across sessions|Zero telemetry, fully offline, no account needed|GPLv3 open source — auditable, modifiable, redistributable
fields.target_audience: Students (high school, university); Researchers; Educators; IT administrators in schools/universities; Professionals on locked-down workstations
